protocol.primary: sum over all three printed rows of squared cumulative radius at every glyph
protocol.row_initial: origin separately for each printed row
nulls: independent uniform rowwise exact directed-bigram/endpoints ensemble
protocol.secondary: per-row exact tails; first two rows combined labelled diagnostic, not selected discovery
protocol.transcriptions: both reported separately, no best-version selection
protocol.constraints: no resets at dots, no image edits, no language or key optimisation
protocol.scope: exploratory direction inherited from previous rounds; protocol frozen before new statistic/control results
